label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy _____.
verse: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
note: Jesus to faithful Philadelphia — hold on, so no one takes your crown.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the _____ when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
verse: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
note: Deborah's song ends by wishing that all who love God would shine like the sun rising in its might.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with _____.
verse: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
note: Rehoboam ignored the elders' advice and threatened scorpions instead of whips — and the kingdom split in two.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with _____ heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verse: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
note: Peter's day-of-the-Lord forecast: the very elements melting — the ultimate controlled burn.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the _____ plant of a strange vine unto me?
verse: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
note: God planted 'a noble vine, wholly a right seed' — how did it turn into the 'degenerate plant of a strange vine'?
